summary: Summoning order validity; complaint filed after 20 years of party registration alleging false declaration on secularism; conflict between Constitution submitted to ECI versus GEC; religious management as secular activity; reliance on S.R. Bommai precedent; no abuse of process found; complaint not time-barred; summoning order upheld; appeals dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; summons to face trial upheld; High Court judgment affirmed.
